summary: Aldel Financial II Inc., a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, filed an 8-K after shareholders at an October 5, 2026 extraordinary general meeting approved charter and trust amendments letting it extend its business-combination deadline from October 23, 2026 monthly up to fifteen times to January 23, 2028. Holders of 24,589,695 shares, or 82.33% of the record-date count, were represented. The charter amendment was to be filed with the Cayman Registrar on October 8, 2026, and the trust agreement amendment is dated October 7, 2026. Watch redemption levels, monthly extension funding, and any announced target.
